search_policy: First formal delivery remains one green.
After first delivered, one isolated casualty is eligible before a distant mixed-pile detour.
Use existing calibrated per-track approach distance bands shared by every compared candidate; fallback only to shared finite metric coordinates.
Prefer casualty if no farther than the nearest material. If distance cannot be compared, retain previous material priority.
A new priority never substitutes an already locked approach or carried manifest; non-isolated casualty still follows ordinary sorting.
state_source_change.tradeoff: Range bands are coarse engineering calibration, not measured ground truth; equal-band priority optimizes score opportunities without claiming shortest physical path. Same-view singleton evidence cannot prove occluded cargo is absent; original claw review remains mandatory.
state_source_change.first_green_confirmation: Two local markers: first_common_delivered retains original MCU-compatible TASK_COMPLETE phase; first_green_visually_confirmed is set only by the existing visual-confirmed outside-to-inside single-green result and only enables the added proactive isolated-orange priority. Missing proof retains original executable selection (green still first if present), without refusing an accidentally caught MCU-legal single black/orange. The first-green absolute-confirmation protocol risk remains unresolved and must not be called fixed.
state_source_change.front_region: Sweep/corridor classify by bbox bottom-centre (contact proxy), retaining explicit inside_safe_zone and foot-in-safe exclusions. Frame4502 blue335 fixed. Original display colouring consumes same predicate; no display renderer change.
state_source_change.reviewed_rejected_variant: Single-marker strict visual-only first_common_delivered was rejected BEFORE delivery: actual F405 would regard later black/orange as legal while RDK regarded it invalid, causing release/disperse refusal. No deployed code changed.
state_source_change.obstacle_view_rebinding: At an actually observed non-retrieval mode39->42 transition, discard the pre-turn obstacle ID and image bbox; retain the obstacle class and original-cargo exclusions. Rebind from currently visible same-class front-floor candidates using the existing centre/area ranking, then retain the new ID within mode42. Mode44/45 original-load retrieval is unchanged. Actual old322 bbox brackets at frames4365/4368 reject new335 without this fix; full CLEAR->39->42->4502 sequence now emits APPROACH335.
state_source_change.obstacle_view_rebinding_tradeoff: Same-class ground candidates after a chassis turn are not proof of physical identity; clearing any eligible obstacle of that class is an intentional candidate choice. Existing original IDs/inside/ground-region exclusions remain. A new-ID original load or camera-dependent inside flag is still an image-association risk to be reviewed with runner evidence.

verification.physical: No UART, SDK, camera, motor, hardware or deployment started. Original logs unchanged.
verification.scope: Only targeted original test module and existing scene constructs; no new stand-alone test program.

findings.behavior: mode42 non-retrieval missing target rotates with no total turn/distance terminal; mode43 invalid audit after existing 3500ms returns42. Actual major long pauses also occur in39, not just42.
Existing empty-audit retry inside mode43 does not establish progress or return original parked cargo.

Reverse trace uses independent F405 Location wheel+gyro pose (not RDK T265/lidar control pose). Endpoint requires along-track crossing plus 20/30mm cross tolerance; remaining<=0 with cross error can keep commanding backward minimum20mm/s and cannot consume endpoint. Which actual subphase stalled is unobservable in the captured status contract.

trace_begin fabricates trace[0] at the pre-parking safe_center, not actual trace-start XY. Second-run reconstructed local Location differs by about35mm after parking; this synthetic final correction and actual observed tail near35mm are consistent with endpoint geometry stress, but no subphase readback proves it was the stalled branch.

actual_lower_source.boundary: No new upper limit/timer/latch added; no false nonempty audit/GRAB invented. Existing protocol lacks upper command to skip a failed obstacle pickup and recover parked original cargo.

latest_logs_scope.green_blue: Actual frame9436 in second replay is mode39 after obstacle grab with green+danger, not ordinary cargo auditing. Must not claim ordinary danger-release regression alone solves this long mechanical phase.
latest_logs_scope.opening: Both runs completed center observation, 140-degree audit and initial stash transport; missing opening continuous video prevents asserting a physical servo-angle fault from data.
